cues.text:
Be the way, be the way
Be the way, be the way
Thomas asked Him in the shadow of the cross

Lord, we don't know the road, and we don't know the cost
And Jesus turned and looked him in the eye

I am the way, the truth, the life
No one comes to the Father but through Me

Then He opened up His hands and said, follow Me
So be the way, be the way
Let them see Jesus in the love you give away

Be the truth, be the life
Let the whole world look at us and find the Christ
They called us The Way before they called us anything
So be the way, be the way
They never knew us by a building or a sign

They knew us by the way we loved, the way we shined
So let my hands be His hands where I stand

Let my walking be the gospel that they read
So be the way, be the way
Let them see Jesus in the love you give away

Be the truth, be the life
Let the whole world look at us and find the Christ
They called us The Way before they called us anything

So be the way, be the way
If they never read a chapter, never turn a page
Let them read it in my kindness, let them read it in my grace

I am not the light, but I can carry it
I am not the road, but I can walk it

Be the way (be the way)
Be the truth (be the truth)

Be the life (be the life)
Till they see Him, till they see Him

Be the way
Be the way
